captures.description: GDPVAL, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'an AI benchmark created by OpenAI to measure how well artificial intelligence models perform on real-world, economically valuable knowledge-work tasks rather than academic or math tests.' Scope (1,320 tasks, 44 occupations, the top 9 U.S. GDP sectors), task design by professionals averaging 14 years' experience, blind head-to-head expert grading, the 220-task gold subset on Hugging Face and arXiv, and Artificial Analysis's GDPval-AA leaderboard. Seven cards: two OpenAI pages, arXiv, Hugging Face, Artificial Analysis, Inspect Evals, a video.
